title: Late participation advantage in `MemePredictionMarket`
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The current design of MemePredictionMarket allows users to make predictions for most of the round's duration (e.g., a 24-hour round with prediction open for 23 hours), which unintentionally benefits late participants. These users can observe more price action and make better-informed decisions than early participants, leading to an unfair advantage.
